# proxmox_cpu_flags (Data Source)

Lists CPU flags known to `/cluster/qemu/cpu-flags`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_cpu_flags" "f" { arch = "x86_64" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `accel` (String) Accelerator (`kvm` or `tcg`).
- `arch` (String) CPU architecture.

### Read-Only

- `flags` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flags))

<a id="nestedatt--flags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flags`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `supported_on` (List of String)
